name: Patrobas
title: Christian in the church at Rome
summary: Patrobas was a Christian in the church at Rome whom Paul greeted in his letter to the Romans. He is mentioned as part of a community of believers who worked for the cause of the gospel in the capital city. His name was common among slaves and freedmen in the Roman world.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Patrobas is mentioned by Paul among a group of Christians in Rome to whom the apostle sends his greetings, showing that he was a well-known and respected member of the church.

keyEvents.title: Part of a Christian community
keyEvents.description: Patrobas likely belonged to a house church in Rome together with Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Hermas, and other believers who were greeted collectively by Paul.
